subject: English
question_text: From your reading of the passage, give one of the reasons of armed conflict between two countries.
guide_solution: Freedom is the birth-right of man, but sometimes this right is denied to a nation by foreign rulers. As a result, armed conflict takes place between the freedom-loving people and the occupation forces.

subject: English
question_text: What do you mean by 'Freedom is the birth-right of a man?
guide_solution: Freedom is the birth-ritht of man that means the basic human right which brings mental pleasure in the heart of human being. If this right is denied to a nation by foreign countries, a conflict starts.

question_text: What do you know about our War of Independence?
guide_solution: I know that the people of Bangladesh fought a glorious War of Independence against the Pakistani army forces in 1971 and the people from all walks of life took part in this War and they won after defeating the well-trained Pakistani forces.

subject: English
question_text: Describe in 2/3 sentences about the heroism of our freedom fighters.
guide_solution: A freedom fighter fights for a noble cause which is the freedom of the motherland. Many of the freedom fighters sacrificed their lives for the causes of the motherland. The freedom fighters are the golden sons of Bangladesh and her pride.

subject: English
question_text: Do you support the idea that the people of this soil will cherish the memory of the valiant sons forever? Why/Why not? Explain in 2/3 sentences
guide_solution: Yes, I support the idea that the people of this soil will cherish the memory of the valiant sons forever. Because they sacrificed their lives for the causes of the motherland. We are indebted to these noble freedom fighters for our freedom. So they are the golden sons of Bangladesh.
